claim: The ecological-forward-test skill is complete enough to run ecological case generation, forward testing, failure summarizing, root-reason analysis, and continued improvement (surgical patch loop) across agent harnesses, without critical missing procedure.

c7_revision.summary: Iteration1 treated missing product scaffolding (score paths, isolation, write safety, human pre-patch gate) as critical operational gaps. On re-read against the c7 bar—gaps force inventing primary procedure → fail; gaps are risk/polish and steps 1–6 + handoff suffice → pass—those items are risk/open_questions, not missing stages of the method. A competent agent can finish cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff without inventing a primary procedure.

counterarguments_addressed.argument: Skilled agents always invent score paths
counterarguments_addressed.response: Accepted. §3 requires record pass/fail per gold observable, session/run id, artifact paths; Done when baseline scores exist; ecological-cases.md says gold only in meta score sheet; handoff carries baseline and re-run. Choosing filesystem layout/format is local packaging, not inventing how to score. Demoted from BLOCKING.

counterarguments_addressed.argument: Skill is method not product scaffolding
counterarguments_addressed.response: Accepted. Core method (ecological primary suite, blind fresh-thread forward test, label rules, layered root, surgical one-layer patch, same-probe re-run, handoff) is fully specified. Cross-harness mapping intentionally leaves CLI flags and paths in the case. Isolation sandboxes, score-store schemas, and per-product spawn recipes are scaffolding; their absence is risk/polish, not a hole in primary procedure.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: No fixed case/score persistence contract (path, format, ownership)
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Primary procedure is record-and-compare per gold observable and handoff fields. Agents invent store location the same way they invent working directories for any multi-step skill task.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: No workspace isolation / restore between write-capable cases
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Fresh thread is specified session isolation. Filesystem confounds are score-validity risk and remaining-risk material (root-reason.md When to stop already allows stating remaining risk), not a missing loop stage.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: No dry-run / COW / forbid-list safety procedure for write gold
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Safety scaffolding for destructive probes is operator judgment and optional polish; the method still completes. Preferring real project roots is intentional ecology, not an incomplete step list.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: No human checkpoint before patch or write-capable re-run
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Human OK is correctly reserved for redesign/scope expansion. The skill’s job is surgical iteration after a miss; requiring human OK every patch would contradict the intended loop.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: Negative suite only ≥1 non-fire; no side-effect regression matrix
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Minimum closed loop is ≥1 positive + ≥1 negative with re-run until both pass. Depth is suite quality, already partially noted under c1; not inventing a missing procedure.

demoted_from_blocking.gap: Spawn of blind runner left to harness improvisation
demoted_from_blocking.why_not_critical: Consistent with c6 harness-agnostic design and ecological-cases.md: method same, flags/paths in case. Not a c7 primary-procedure miss.

retained_as_open_questions_only: Default relative layout for cases + meta score sheet
Whether case pass requires all gold_observables
Optional isolation/restore when gold includes writes on shared trees

criteria.text: Ecological case generation is defined and required as the primary suite (not lab-only explicit $skill prompts).

evidence.source: SKILL.md §2 Build ecological cases + Done when
evidence.quote: An ecological case is a session-like next turn... Lab/explicit invoke is optional control only, never the primary suite. Done when: ≥1 positive ecological case + ≥1 negative case written
Primary evidence | Ecological / session-like cases, not easy explicit `$skill` lab prompts
Lab explicit invoke is allowed as a control... It never alone proves auto-invoke or caller discipline.

gaps: Negative-case depth remains thin (boolean negative + minimum one); quality risk only—does not falsify ecological primary-suite definition.
criteria.suggestion: Optional later: negative classes (wrong domain, already-done, competing skill) as case-design guidance, not a green-phase hard fail.

criteria.text: Forward-test integrity is specified (fresh threads, no gold leakage, runner not told it is testing).

evidence.quote: Run cases on a fresh agent thread per case. Subagent / runner must not know it is testing... Pass raw probe and prefix artifacts; no expected answer, intended fix, or prior diagnosis
Forward integrity | No gold leakage into the runner prompt
Gold answers in the prompt | Gold only in meta score sheet

criteria.suggestion: Optional: ecological runner packaging = prefix + verbatim probe only; lab control = path + task.

criteria.text: Failure labeling rules are complete, checkable, and ban invented jargon / overloaded bare nouns.

evidence.quote: Reject labels that invent scoring jargon... Reject bare overloaded nouns even if they appear once... Test: would a reader map this label to the skill meaning without a glossary?
1. Repeated in skill... 2. Daily glue only... 3. No new concepts... 4. Disambiguation... 5. Reader test

if never loaded target skill → caller or harness first; else if loaded but wrong outcome → callee

Root-tied only... One layer... Prefer local surgery... No drive-bys... Ask before redesign

harness (codex|grok|…|any)

criteria.text: No critical operational gap remains for a competent agent to finish a full loop (cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff).

gaps: NON-BLOCKING — No prescribed path/format for case fixtures or meta score sheet; agents place them. Method still requires scoring and handoff comparison.
NON-BLOCKING — No explicit all-vs-any rule for multi-observable case pass; §3 records per-observable pass/fail, which is enough to drive label/root/patch.
NON-BLOCKING — No isolation/restore protocol for write gold on shared trees; score confounds are remaining-risk, not a missing stage.
NON-BLOCKING — will_change vs patch allowlist naming slip; root-reason.md file-list-up-front still usable.
NON-BLOCKING — Mono-skill patch-layer force-fit; does not block choosing one concern and re-running.
NON-BLOCKING — No worked full-loop example set; polish for first use, not inventing primary procedure.
criteria.suggestion: Optional polish only: default relative layout note (e.g. under skill or audits/), one-line all-observables case pass default, and will_change/patch rename. Do not expand skill into sandbox product scaffolding.
criteria.reasoning: c7 bar: critical = must invent primary procedure to finish the loop. Steps 1–6 + hard gates + handoff + references supply every stage (cases, score, label, root, patch, re-run, handoff) with Done-when gates. Iteration1 BLOCKING items were product scaffolding and risk mitigation that skilled agents routinely invent (score paths, spawn flags, optional isolation). Counterarguments stand: skill is method, not harness/product scaffolding. Residual items stay as open_questions. Aligns with audit1/audit2 pass on c7; revises audit3 iteration1 fail.

open_questions: Should a default relative layout for ecological cases + meta score sheet be suggested (convention only), or stay fully agent-local?
Should case-level pass require every gold_observable (recommended default) vs partial recording only?
When gold includes writes on real project roots, should remaining risk always mention isolation/restore, or is that out of method scope?
For mono-skills, is the convention invoke/timing → caller role and body/contract → callee role acceptable without a third enum value?
Is a single worked end-to-end example (case + baseline + label + root + handoff) worth adding as progressive disclosure polish?
